heading: Why homeowners keep our number.
subtext: Most calls come from a referral or a repeat customer. Here's the short list of why people switch and stay.

cards.title: Same plumber every visit
cards.body: You get Mike — every time. No rotating techs, no "a colleague will follow up," no commission-driven upsell. Knowing the house is half the work.

cards.title: Honest, transparent pricing
cards.body: Flat-rate on common service calls. Free written estimates on projects $500+. The number on the quote matches the number on the invoice. No diagnostic fee on top of repair.

cards.title: Real photos, real documentation
cards.body: Every job, every fitting, every drain run — photographed before drywall closes. Written invoice, photo report, and warranty terms in writing. Property managers love this part.

cards.title: Direct line, real human
cards.body: Phone goes straight to me. After-hours and weekends too. If I can't talk in the moment, you get a real text-back inside 15 minutes — not a call-center holding pattern.
